item.title: Rallying Cry – June 11, 2026
item.description: From Wegovy’s new pill form in the UK to a baby elephant’s adorable ball-playing debut, plus China’s Tianwen-2 reaching a quasi-moon and Singapore’s bold bet on synthetic biology, today’s good news is full of breakthroughs and heartwarming moments.
